item.title: View and Customize Platform Information
item.description: This section describes how to view and customize the information of the KubeSphere Enterprise web console. Prerequisites You should have the Platform Settings Management permission on the KubeSphere Enterprise platform. For more information, refer to "Platform Roles". Steps Log in to the KubeSphere Enterprise web console with a user who has the Platform Settings Management permission. In the upper right corner, click Component Dock > Platform Settings.

item.title: KubeSphere as an OIDC Identity Provider
item.description: OpenID Connect is an interoperable authentication protocol based on the OAuth 2.0 specification framework (IETF RFC 6749 and 6750). Since KubeSphere Enterprise v4.1.3, it implements the Authorization Code Flow from the OpenID Connect protocol, enabling extensions to connect to KubeSphere’s account system. This tutorial uses Harbor as an OIDC client. After configuration, KubeSphere accounts will be used to log in to Harbor. Basic SSO Flow Based on OIDC
